entities.name: Xicotencatl II

entities.summary: Xicotencatl II Axayacatl, also known as Xicotencatl the Younger, was a prince and warleader, probably with the title of Tlacochcalcatl, of the pre-Columbian state of Tlaxcallān at the time of the Spanish conquest of the Aztec Empire.
